subject: The truth about your first 14 days with Predictify
preview_text: We analyzed your activity and discovered something you might have missed. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago you downloaded an app to get smarter about football. Most people open it once, get overwhelmed, and forget it. But you're not most people. We checked your stats.

In 14 days, you've seen predictions for 42+ matches across the leagues you follow. You've scanned player xG stats, checked head-to-head histories, and absorbed tactical analysis that 95% of fans never see. That's not just downloading an app. That's building a data-driven edge. The kind that turns gut feelings into knowing.

Here's the secret most users miss: Predictify gets sharper the more you use it. Those 14 days of checking scores against our AI predictions? That's training your eye. You're starting to see patterns in possession stats and defensive efficiency that casual fans ignore. The 'Confidence Score' on each match isn't just a number—it's your new benchmark for what a smart bet looks like.

Open the app right now. Tap on 'My Activity'. See your 2-week snapshot. It shows you exactly which leagues you're tracking and how our predictions stacked up. It's the proof you're ahead of the curve. P.S. The users who check this snapshot after 14 days are 3x more likely to spot a value bet in the next 48 hours. Your timing is perfect.
